blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA–Under 1,000 spectators watched Asian Games host Japan beat South Korea in the semi-finals of the women’s football at a 50,000-capacity stadium, highlighting the struggle to generate interest in some events. It came hours after organizers in Aichi-Nagoya said Tuesday that more than one million tickets had been sold for the continent’s biggest sporting spectacular.
